description: An example wave: the Harbour theme's frame, looks, look editor, style sheet and 404, one story per surface. Replace the theme, the stories and their files with your own; keep every story's files under themeDir.

userStories.title: theme.json, the entry and the frame
userStories.description: As a member, I want Harbour's frame around every page, so the app is Harbour's while the host keeps its data and its header.
acceptanceCriteria: theme.json as guides/contract.md says: id acme/harbour, htmlClass harbour, base studio, tone from-look, minWidth 1024, slots frame@1, lookEditor@1 and styleSheet@1
src/entry.ts registers the frame, and a placeholder look editor and style sheet from src/screens/index.ts, with defineTheme
The frame renders its children, the host's HeaderUtilities and a menu of HostLink links
Every CSS rule sits under html.harbour and every variable starts with --harbour-
test/frame.test.tsx renders the frame on the harness and finds the page, the menu and the header utilities
CI green on the wave's pull request

userStories.title: The look data: schema, presets, first paint and colour pairs
userStories.description: As a member, I want Harbour's looks to read well on every ground, so whichever look I pick stays readable.
acceptanceCriteria: looks/schema.json has choice knobs ground and accent and a number knob radius (guides/looks.md)
Two presets, paper (the default, named by theme.json look) and ink, each with a value for every knob
boot/prepaint.json paints every knob's variables, the accent text per ground through a pair table with every cell, Studio's --background and --foreground as triplets, and a tone rule on ground
design/contrast.json declares every text-on-ground pair, and the accent on each ground with min 3
CI's npm run pack runs automatos-theme check design first (the theme's pack script): no pair under its minimum on either preset

userStories.title: The look editor and the style sheet
userStories.description: As a member, I want to pick, change, save, export and import a look, so Harbour is mine.
acceptanceCriteria: The look editor reads useLook() and offers each knob's choices, Save, Export and Import, each refusal shown in its plain words
The style sheet shows the active look's type and colours
test/looks.test.tsx drives both on the harness's looks runtime (host.setLooks)
CI green on the wave's pull request

userStories.title: The 404 screen
userStories.description: As a member, I want a lost page to look like Harbour, so I know where I am.
acceptanceCriteria: notFound@1 is listed in theme.json and registered in src/entry.ts
The screen has one heading and a link back to the chat (CHAT_HREF)
CI green on the wave's pull request
